In person.|[[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Sollaw ap-Orwien]] and [[Clone Captain/Legends|Clone Captain]] [[Rex/Legends|CT-7567]]|<ref name="Speaking Silently">{{InsiderCite|139|Speaking Silently}}</ref>}}
A '''T-series tactical droid''' served as a field [[Commander/Legends|commander]] during a [[Battle of Ereesus|battle]] on [[Ereesus]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. It was destroyed during the battle, with its cranial unit being captured by the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic's]] [[Torrent Company/Legends|Torrent Company]].
